create.name: Laura Hollick
create.bio:
Laura Hollick is an artist and creative guide who weaves painting, collage, ritual and guided visualisation into a spiritual practice she calls Soul Art. Her training began at Dundas Valley's art school, followed by a fine arts degree at McMaster University, and she credits a vision quest made on foot, some ten thousand kilometres long, with showing her what her work should be. She then set up Soul Art Studio, the company through which she runs her teaching and her large online art gatherings, such as the Global Vision Quest, Yoni Art Fest and an annual International Soul Art Day.

In her teaching, making art becomes a way of meeting the inner life: students are led through visualisations, journalling and creative rituals that help them get clear about what they want to bring into the world. Nearly all of it happens online, through Soul Art School, a year-long membership with a library of recorded rituals and a live session each month, through guided audio meditations, and through trainings in Soul Art and Yoni Art for people who want to guide others with her methods. Alongside this she makes embodiment imagery with the photographer Kevin Thom, has hosted hundreds of episodes of an arts radio programme and has given a TEDx talk.

videos.title: Meet Your Future Self Guided Soul Art Visualization

courses.title: Soul Art School
courses.description: A one-year online membership built around a library of recorded Soul Art rituals, with a new live ritual each month and a private community space. Members work through monthly themes using creative practices aimed at finding their purpose and expressing it.

courses.title: Reimagine Your Life Meditation
courses.description: A thirty-minute guided audio meditation, bought once and downloaded. It invites the listener to treat fear and doubt as openings and to look for fresh ideas about the shape of their life.

free_resources.title: Meet Your Future Self
free_resources.description: A free guided Soul Art visualisation with a downloadable journal, given in exchange for joining her newsletter. It takes the listener to meet an image of who they are becoming and to ask what comes next.

free_resources.title: Light Body Activation
free_resources.description: A short free guided meditation with a journal, offered through her newsletter sign-up. It centres on sensing light within the body and a felt connection to the divine.
